feature_status.data_contract: Canonical first-run readiness contract. Tool discovery never overrides the returned availability and prerequisite states.

catalog-derived protocol metadata. Scores are exposed as discovery_heuristic_score = catalog EDITORIAL heuristic (static strings, hand-curated flags) — explicitly NOT live Trail Heat and not decision-grade quantitative data. Every response carries score_semantics.

THE canonical quantitative Trail Heat (DeFiLlama-backed). Every numeric field carries a data_evidence state: observed (measured upstream now), derived (computed by documented formula), editorial (hand-curated, excluded from the quantitative score), stale (past freshness window), or unavailable (no data — never substituted with 0). Protocols whose upstream entity cannot be confidently resolved return registry_resolution=unresolved with all components unavailable rather than a guessed score.
public wallet balance reads only; never private keys or signatures
report endpoints use the shared 402/x402 negotiation contract
session state only; execution authority remains with local signatures or explicit bounded delegation

FarmDashIntent v2 supports durable creation, policy, simulation, approval, and preparation records. The generic execute endpoint is disabled: it never accepts client-supplied execution receipts and returns execution_verifier_unconfigured until a trusted adapter and server-side transaction verifier are deployed.
Workflow planning and status are supervised orchestration records. Wallet-changing steps retain their own capability, simulation, signature, approval, and receipt gates.

Enabled EVM routes provide wallet-bound quotes, authoritative simulation, EIP-191 validation, customer-submitted calldata, and canonical receipt verification. FarmDash does not broadcast the returned transaction.
Portfolio optimization, natural-language intent resolution, risk sentinel, yield comparison, and hedge recommendations are planning outputs; they do not authorize or submit transactions.
Research is distinct from guarded order operations. Any order or cancellation requires the documented venue authority, current research gate, EIP-712 signature, and risk controls.
Activity and ledger outputs are derived from available FarmDash records. Missing settlement evidence is unavailable, not realized profit or tax certainty.
Allowance and transaction-envelope checks are preflight risk controls, not a smart-contract audit, authoritative RPC simulation, or safety guarantee.

Intent creation and declared-input economics preview are available. Submission and settlement are disabled until a production MEE coordinator and authoritative cross-chain receipt verifier are deployed.
Session-key grants, cycle state, pause/resume, and recommendations exist. Server-side UserOperation calldata construction, signing, bundler submission, and verified settlement remain unavailable.

Provisioning requires a wallet-bound tenant identity, fixed server-side policy, destination allowlist, and configured CDP credentials. The route returns typed 503 states when prerequisites are absent.

A customer-owned registered ACP client creates and funds jobs locally after signing one exact FarmDash tender approval. FarmDash is a separately registered evaluator: it verifies bound jobs, consensus, simulation, and Base receipts, then may complete or reject only those customer-funded escrow jobs. FarmDash cannot create, fund, or spend the customer wallet.

Tenant-bound, HMAC-signed HTTPS delivery via a durable outbox. It requires migration 028, WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY, CRON_SECRET, and the scheduled /api/cron/deliver-webhooks worker before subscriptions are represented as deliverable.

Confirmation requires the owning active session and a successful canonical-chain receipt with the exact server-committed ERC-20 fee asset, payer, recipient, amount, and required finality. A successful but unrelated transaction cannot settle a fee event.

intent_contract.rule: State-changing agent actions must use typed FarmDashIntent lifecycle records and curated protocol adapters; raw arbitrary calldata is blocked unless an adapter is explicitly trusted. Creating, approving, or preparing an intent is not evidence that FarmDash has executed it.

execution_capabilities.rule: Discovery and analytics coverage is broader than compatibility-swap execution. A chain is enabled for execution only when quote, authoritative simulation, local signing, and receipt verification are all available.

data_confidence_contract.rule: Agents should lower recommendation confidence or ask for user confirmation when confidence is low or demo.

evidence_state_contract.description: Canonical Trail Heat outputs attach a per-number data_evidence state so agents can distinguish measured market data from computed, curated, aged-out, or missing values.

states.observed: measured directly from the upstream provider at fetch time (e.g. currentTvl from DeFiLlama /tvl/{slug})
states.derived: computed from observed inputs by a documented formula (e.g. momentum from historical series)
states.editorial: hand-curated human judgment; NEVER included in the quantitative score (e.g. editorial.bonusRaw)
states.stale: last known value past its freshness window
states.unavailable: no data exists; fields are null — zero is only ever an observed zero

evidence_state_contract.entity_resolution: protocols carry registry_resolution; unresolved means no confident upstream mapping — all quantitative components are unavailable rather than guessed
evidence_state_contract.historical_vintages: historical-trailheat snapshots carry evidence_vintage: canonical-live (post-cutover, has data_evidence) vs legacy-editorial-heuristic (pre-cutover catalog scores; not quantitatively comparable)

components.tvl: 44.4% (40/90 raw) calibrated log-scaled current DeFiLlama TVL; $1M ~= 10/40, $1B+ ~= 40/40
components.momentum: 27.8% (25/90 raw) seven-day observed TVL momentum; null when history unavailable — never worst-case zero
components.diversification: 16.7% (15/90 raw) chain distribution from DeFiLlama currentChainTvls; single-chain live protocols receive a neutral baseline instead of zero
components.category: 11.1% (10/90 raw) category baseline comparison among live protocols (TVL >= $1M)
components.editorial: EXCLUDED from the quantitative score. Hand-curated editorial bonuses are reported separately in the editorial field and carry data_evidence.state=editorial.

trail_heat_canonical.normalization: The four quantitative components sum to a 90-point raw ceiling; the headline score rescales that raw total to 0-100 ((raw/90)*100). Editorial is never part of either the raw total or the rescale.
trail_heat_canonical.unavailable_semantics: Protocols whose upstream entity cannot be confidently resolved return score=null with data_evidence.score=unavailable and registry_resolution=unresolved. Null scores are excluded from averages, rankings, and snapshot persistence. Zero is only ever an OBSERVED zero.
caveats: Live Trail Heat is a transparent heuristic, not a backtested investment model.
When upstream data is missing, fields are null with evidence state unavailable — values are never fabricated.
Use confidence, sources, and data_evidence before handing results to execution tools.

components.tvl: 2-30 points from calibrated log-scaled static catalog TVL when available
components.status: 5-25 points from FarmDash program status labels
components.momentum: 7-15 points from hot flag and recency

caveats: Discovery heuristic is an editorial ranking aid, NOT live Trail Heat and not decision-grade quantitative data.
Catalog-derived TVL fields are less reliable than live source-confirmed TVL.
Airdrop rules, TVL, and program status can change without notice.
discovery_heuristic_catalog.note: editorial heuristic for discovery/filtering only — exposed as discovery_heuristic_score, never as Trail Heat
